reviews.title: Truly the best sleep tracker
reviews.text: I’ve been using the Prime (now Noxogy) Sleep Recorder for years now, and I can easily say that it is the best one on the App Store by far. It’s extremely straightforward and intuitive to use, does a great job of clearly recording sounds and categorizing them correctly, and I love that you can easily ‘favorite’ any soundbites and title them accordingly. The only downside for me is that sometimes the app will go unresponsive when I’m trying to start the recording process, but this is easily resolved by fully closing out of the app and reopening it. All in all, an excellent app that I’ll continue to use on a nightly basis for years to come!

reviews.title: Best Sleep Tracker App I’ve Tried
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Prime Sleep Tracker for about 6 months now, and it is hands down the best sleep tracker app I’ve tried. I tested two others before this, and honestly, they don’t even come close.

The subscription is inexpensive and totally worth it. I was diagnosed with a deviated septum years ago and kept putting off seeing an ENT. I also had a sleep study done years back, and they tried to put me on a CPAP, but I can’t use those because the straps around my head trigger migraines. Thanks to the excellent recordings from this app, I now have actual proof to bring to my new ENT that I basically snore loud enough to take the roof off my house.

Another thing I really appreciate is that I live alone, and there’s something oddly comforting about knowing that if anyone ever tried to enter my home, this app would be recording everything. So yes, it tracks my sleep, but it also gives me a little extra peace of mind.

The customer service is absolutely incredible too. They actually respond, they’re helpful, and they clearly care about the user experience.

The only thing I wish they would fix is the “farting” label… it’s definitely not that, it’s just me sounding like I belong in a cartoon, snoring. Other than that, this app is excellent, accurate, easy to use, and genuinely helpful.

Highly recommend, especially if you need real recordings to show a doctor, or if you just want undeniable evidence that you are, in fact, the problem.
